Ads are about to launch on Apple Maps in the US and Canada, and merchants can start booking their own ads from today. Here are the details, including a limited-time promotional offer for merchants.

Merchants can book Apple Maps ads starting today

If you own your own business and want to advertise through Apple Maps, the booking service has officially launched today.

Although users will not see ads go live for the time being, Apple has already begun allowing merchants to book ads in preparation for the full launch.

Complete information on ad bookings is available on the Apple website, which includes step-by-step details on how to get started.

Apple has also launched a special limited-time offer, details as follows:

This offer applies to eligible merchants who book Maps ads with credit card payment on or before October 11, 2026.

As announced earlier this year, ads will appear in two places on Apple Maps:

  • Before users search: The "Suggested Places" section of the search screen will display merchant ads.
  • After users search: When relevant to the search results, ads will appear in the search results.

If you are considering advertising on Apple Maps, there is also a dedicated page on the Apple website explaining their approach to handling ads, details can be found here.
